title: Roblox Studio MCP bridge on Linux via Vinegar
content:
Roblox Studio’s MCP server (StudioMCP.exe, “studio_mcp_proxy”) works on Linux only by running Studio’s own mcp.bat inside the Vinegar Flatpak Wine prefix. The wrapper lives at /OpenCode-Sandbox/roblox-studio-mcp/roblox-studio-mcp.sh and is registered with OpenCode as the local MCP server “roblox-studio”. Confirmed working: stdio MCP initialize returns serverInfo.name=RobloxStudio, and the proxy binds 127.0.0.1:13469. BLOCKER (reproduced twice): Studio’s WebSocket upgrade to the proxy never completes, so tools/list stays empty; and when the proxy process exits, Studio’s main thread hangs (StudioHangMonitor) and wedges the wineserver, requiring a full Vinegar restart.
